exercise_answer_checks.checked_conclusion: The declared two-DOF linear spring has K=diag(4,1) N/mm; local unit displacements give forces [4,0]/[0,1] N and energies 2/0.5 N*mm. These are stipulated response coefficients, not measured continuum textile properties.

Active rotation gives K_world=R K R^T, quarter-turn diag(1,4). A fixed [1,0] mm world displacement changes force/energy from [4,0],2 to [1,0],0.5; fixed [1,0] N force gives displacements [0.25,0] versus [1,0] mm. Geometry alone does not determine the material law.
The 45-degree matrix is [[2.5,1.5],[1.5,2.5]]. It maps [1,0] to [2.5,1.5] with energy1.25, and [1,-1] to [1,-1] with energy1. Removing off-diagonals gives [2.5,-2.5] and energy2.5, a changed model.

Rotating displacement and stiffness together preserves their relative state, quadratic energy and force covariance; a fixed-world probe changes relative orientation. All36 authored six-angle/six-displacement cases retain floating residuals. Eigenvalues1/4 ensure positivity only in the ideal linear model.

Actual pinned scene builds isolated colored boxes/static collision bodies. Godot optical anisotropy controls a specular highlight; PhysicsMaterial controls collision, while StaticBody3D does not move under external forces/contacts. IX parallel-panel geometry is not calibrated stiffness or universal manufacture. Future specimen/directions/units/boundaries/load/displacement, fitted simple baseline, independent checks, uncertainty and artisan assessment are proposed, unperformed.

FOLD draft1.2 defines [f,g,s] relative to second face g's normal. d=s*sigma_g makes [2,5,+1] globally above for sigma_g+1 and below for sigma_g-1; argument positions and known nonzero normal signs remain explicit.
Swapping gives t=-d*sigma_f=-s*sigma_f*sigma_g. Opposite normals retain s; equal normals negate it. With sigma_g=-1,sigma_f=+1,s=+1, d=-1 and t=+1, yielding [5,2,+1].

Whole-object turnover reverses d and both normal signs, preserving stored s. An additional s flip implies the original global order and contradicts the intended turnover. IX folded-y reflection/source comments support this boundary, not a fresh native transformation or a universal host-axis mapping.

Recoloring preserves roles/order. Renaming warp/weft complements the role bit while preserving the old physical strand's height; whole turnover with retained role labels also complements that bit but reverses its height relation. A bit alone does not identify the operation; roles, identities, frame and provenance matter.

Zero/omitted FOLD order remains unknown, not equal height/nonintersection. IX validates supplied orders without inferring a complete one. A minimal typed record/table validator may preserve necessary reference/identity/revision information; no new DSL, adapter or physical certification follows.
